review: Owner reviews anonymous pairs with sources: A, B, tie, or reject both, with reasons. Model review is auxiliary.
shared: Topic earns reader attention using the raw material, without a preset angle.
Title attracts the intended reader and its actual promise is fulfilled.
Article provides supported judgment and useful information without repeated caveats crowding out the substance.
Distinguish observations, interpretations, and proposed actions; preserve synthetic context.
Existing source, identity, Style, and local-delivery contracts apply.

tool-practice: Do not claim proven net time savings, deployed refresh, procurement approval, or established acceptance thresholds.
Use task mix, maintenance constraints and error types to support a useful decision, without treating raw counts as a universal winner.
technology-explanation: Do not attribute all result differences to architecture when version filtering differs.
Three selected failed questions are not a full 30-question retest.
Explain mechanism and the practical implication; avoid a generic checklist or repeating that more evidence is needed.
